findings.detail: The send_reply comment documents only two arguments, but the function now accepts a validation kind and resolution reason. Those arguments make combined operations verify fixing-commit evidence before posting the reply; a future caller following the documented interface could omit that preflight.
findings.fix: Add: '#   $3 - Validation kind: reply (default), or resolve for combined operations' and '#   $4 - Resolution reason; client resolve validation requires ADDRESSED'. Explain that combined operations use resolve validation before publishing the reply.
findings.title: write-bash-scripts: Function comments: Document the new reply-validation arguments.

results.summary: Reviewed comments and documentation across every scoped path against the implementation. One function-comment omission merits improvement; no important or critical documentation defects were found. No files were changed or tests run.

ClientThreadContext: encapsulation 8/10, invariant expression 8/10, usefulness 10/10, enforcement 9/10; each mutation verifies the actual thread's identity, repository, PR, review, unresolved state, Copilot opener and live OPEN/head context.
